notes: COL.2.4's head on *persuasiveness* contradicts COL.2.23's head on *worship* for one construction — a Greek compound noun rendered by two English words each of which glosses one of its elements. The source licenses no difference between them, and the only thing that could carry the 2.4 reading is that *persuasiveness* stands first and is the English phrase's formal head, the two grounds rule 17 excludes in terms. Rule 91's recorded rows for this exact shape (καταλαλιάς → *evil speakings* on *speakings*, δυσφημίας → *evil report* on *report*) put the head on the element answering to the compound's nominal core, so s008's target head moves from t011 to t013.
